Markets.title: US stocks: US market ends down sharply; worries about AI trade and high oil prices weigh
Markets.summary: US stocks fell sharply on Friday due to renewed selling in AI-related technology stocks and rising oil prices. The S&P 500, Dow Jones, and Nasdaq all recorded substantial losses amid concerns over AI infrastructure debt and economic stability.

Markets.title: Big US bank stocks head for longest weekly losing streak since 2008
Markets.summary: Major US bank stocks are experiencing their longest weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis. This downturn is driven by mixed quarterly earnings, rising inflation, and concerns that artificial intelligence will disrupt financial services.

Markets.title: Chip selloff deepens Wall Street losses as doubts grew over AI returns
Markets.summary: Semiconductor stocks drove Wall Street lower as investors grew concerned over the profitability of artificial intelligence investments. This selloff caused the Nasdaq 100 to drop by 1.8%, marking its longest losing streak since 2008.

Markets.title: CoreWeave stock wipeout exposes divide between AI fear and greed
Markets.summary: CoreWeave is facing stock volatility and default fears driven by rising bond yields and heavy debt, despite a temporary boost from Nvidia's endorsement. Although analysts believe strong AI demand could offset interest rate concerns, investor sentiment remains cautious regarding the company's pressing funding needs.

Markets.title: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals Ltd Q2 Results: Profit surges 65% to Rs 124 crore
Markets.summary: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals reported a 65 percent increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 124 crore for the September quarter. Revenue from operations jumped 18.15 percent, driven by strong growth in the electric consumer durable segment, particularly fans and appliances.

Markets.title: Cult.fit receives Sebi approval for proposed IPO
Markets.summary: Fitness platform Cult.fit has received regulatory approval from Sebi for its proposed initial public offering, which includes a fresh issue of up to Rs 950 crore and an offer for sale. The company's revenue grew by 36.26% in fiscal year 2026 alongside a significant improvement in its adjusted EBITDA margin as it expanded nationwide.

Geo-Political.title: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC accompanied Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi as it successfully used Starlink terminals to recapture crucial territory in the Donbas. However, this military progress is tempered by growing concerns over deteriorating diplomatic relations with U.S. President Trump.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
Geo-Political.summary: Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians and a US journalist in the West Bank while they were trying to harvest olives. This assault is part of a recent surge in similar violent incidents in the region.

Geo-Political.title: Trump denies limiting Ukraine access to Starlink network
Geo-Political.summary: Former U.S. President Donald Trump has denied restricting Ukraine's access to the Starlink satellite network. Speed restrictions on the network had previously limited Ukraine's defenses against Russian attacks.

Geo-Political.title: Pope pictured for first time since surgery and cancer diagnosis
Geo-Political.summary: The Pope was diagnosed with lung cancer following surgery at Rome's Gemelli Hospital on Tuesday. He has now been pictured for the first time since receiving the diagnosis.

Geo-Political.title: India's 'cockroach' party founder detained ahead of protest
Geo-Political.summary: The founder of India's youth-led "cockroach" party has been detained ahead of a planned protest in Delhi. This action follows mass detentions last week and the imprisonment of two other movement leaders.

Geo-Political.title: Dad fined after son, 2, died in Cyprus hotel fall
Geo-Political.summary: Joshua Foster was fined after his two-year-old son fell to his death from a Cyprus hotel window. The father lost control of the child while showing him the view of a nearby water park.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates a shift in how organic traffic is generated through AI platforms compared to traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This article lists ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to help creators improve their digital content in 2025. It explains that these technologies are now necessary for creators who want to stay competitive and streamline their workflows.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide provides beginners with an in-depth overview of the CJ Affiliate network and explains how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs, alternatives, and answers frequently asked questions.

Data & Insights.title: 800 million jobs at risk over 15 years? World Bank's Ajay Banga calls for global financing overhaul
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank President Ajay Banga warned that 1.2 billion young people will enter the global workforce over the next decade and a half, leaving an estimated 800 million without jobs. In response, he called for a global financing overhaul while announcing plans to raise critical minerals financing to $19 billion by 2030.

Data & Insights.title: PM-SETU: Five ITI clusters to get  ₹1,195 crore investment from Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, others
Data & Insights.summary: Five industrial training institute (ITI) clusters will receive a ₹1,195 crore investment from companies including Tata Steel Foundation and BVG India under the PM-SETU scheme. This brings the cumulative approved investment under the scheme to ₹3,687 crore.

Data & Insights.title: Vibrant Goa summit to connect 220 Goan MSMEs with 300+ global buyers – What to expect?
Data & Insights.summary: The Government of Goa is hosting a three-day business summit from October 29 to 31 at the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium. The event will connect 220 local MSMEs with over 300 global buyers and business leaders from more than 50 countries.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Most consequential change’: Kevin Warsh says AI will reshape US economy, warns of a ‘bumpy’ road ahead
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stated that artificial intelligence will boost productivity over time while potentially raising inflation in the short term. He also warned that the economic transition will be bumpy due to emerging markets and uncertainty surrounding the technology.

Data & Insights.title: India may hike fuel prices in November, pushing inflation above RBI target: Oxford Economist
Data & Insights.summary: Oxford Economics reports that India may moderately increase fuel prices in November before upcoming state elections early next year. This potential price hike is expected to push inflation above the Reserve Bank of India's target.

Data & Insights.title: Put private sector at center of development agenda: Sitharaman to World Bank
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman urged the World Bank to place the private sector at the center of the global development agenda. She recommended that the lender prioritize job creation and productivity while offering competitive pricing and local currency financing tools.

India.title: Probe Agency ED Summons Pinarayi Vijayan In Money Laundering Case
India.summary: The Enforcement Directorate has summoned Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan in a money laundering case. This follows two FIRs registered by the state's Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Bureau against Vijayan and his family regarding an alleged bribery case involving CMRL.

India.title: Tremors, Tectonic Shifts: Milind Deora, Shashi Tharoor's Banter Over Protests
India.summary: Politicians Milind Deora and Shashi Tharoor engaged in lighthearted banter on social media regarding ongoing protests. Their online exchange was sparked by an initial post made by Deora mentioning an earthquake in Panama.

India.title: Sankoo Becomes Ladakh's 8th District, Gets Separate Hill Council
India.summary: Despite initial omission, Sankoo has been established as Ladakh's eighth district. The newly formed district has also been granted a separate Hill Council.

India.title: 3 Detained After Missing J&K Special Officer's Body Found With Head Injuries
India.summary: Three people have been detained following the discovery of missing Jammu and Kashmir Special Police Officer Bashir Ahmad dead near his home. His body bore visible head injuries a day after he went missing on Thursday morning.

India.title: Tibetan Government-in-Exile Tells World: Prepare Now for Dalai Lama's Succession
India.summary: The Tibetan Government-in-Exile is urging the global community to prepare for the succession of the Dalai Lama. Identifying his successor has become a sensitive dispute between the exiled Tibetans and Beijing.

India.title: TVK Worker Arrested in Drugs Case, Udhayanidhi Stalin Targets Vijay
India.summary: Following the arrest of a TVK worker in a drugs case, Tamil Nadu Deputy Chief Minister Udhayanidhi Stalin questioned actor-politician Vijay's commitment to tackling narcotics. Stalin specifically contrasted the arrest with Vijay's campaign slogan urging youth to give up drugs and take up sports.

General.title: Watch: Will Ukraine get the support needed as tensions with US rise?
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky thanked international leaders ahead of an upcoming European Union meeting in Brussels. This development occurs as tensions rise regarding the level of support Ukraine will receive from the United States.

General.title: Inside Ukrainian offensive pushing Russia back - with Starlink playing a key role
General.summary: BBC reporters joined Ukraine's Operation Vivaldi to witness forces regaining territory in the Donbas with the help of Starlink technology. However, this military success has been overshadowed by deteriorating relations with President Trump.

General.title: Nurse stole £750k from 99-year-old woman for cosmetic surgery and home improvements
General.summary: Former nurse Rebecca Louise Burwood stole £750,000 from a vulnerable 99-year-old victim. She used the stolen money to fund cosmetic surgery and home improvements.

General.title: Man killed by tiger may have had medical records breached by NHS staff
General.summary: William Chapman, 24, was mauled to death by a tiger at Yorkshire Wildlife Park on Saturday. Following the incident, NHS staff may have unlawfully breached his medical records.

General.title: Chris Mason: Burnham and Swinney tussle over where power lies in Scotland
General.summary: Following the SNP's annual conference, UK political debate has taken on a distinctly Scottish focus. BBC political editor Chris Mason reports that Labour's Andy Burnham and the SNP's John Swinney are currently clashing over the allocation of power in Scotland.

General.title: Watch: Did Tesla really just unveil a flying car?
General.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk showcased the vehicle at a facility owned by his SpaceX company, which helped develop the model.
